summary: Advances an animation state by a time fraction: converts the requested time into an integer start frame and a following frame, then walks every active animation track and interpolates its keyframes. Rotation is interpolated with quaternion spherical interpolation; translation and scale components are lerped. Marks the animation state as dirty and clears a caller-supplied bitmask.

operations.description: Load the animation descriptor pointer from this + 0x1C; it supplies duration, frame count, and keyframe table base.
Clamp the requested time to the animation duration stored at this + 0x1C + 8 (this + 0x24).
Convert the time fraction into an integer start frame via CRTFtol and store it into this + 0x8; frame count is read from this + 0x1C + 20 (this + 0x30).
Step the start frame to produce the following frame: increment below frameCount - 1, decrement when at frameCount, and write the result back to this + 0x8.
Load the active track list base from this + 0x18.
Iterate over tracks: loop counter runs up to the track count at this + 0x14, advancing the track pointer by 136 bytes per element.
Skip inactive tracks: when the track state byte read from the this + 0x18 list is 255, the interpolation body is not executed.
Compute the keyframe array base for the track: 44 bytes per track entry offset from this + 0x1C + 16 (this + 0x2C) plus 40; keyframe stride is 32 bytes.
Compute the interpolation factor from the surrounding keyframe times; when the frame times are equal the factor defaults to zero (the zero sentinel global).
Initialize the output quaternion buffer to identity via IdentityFunction_b490.
Spherical interpolation between the previous and following keyframe quaternions using the computed factor.
Copy the interpolated quaternion into the track's rotation slot via sub_53B4C0.
Linearly interpolate the track translation/scale components into track offsets +52, +56 and +60.
Call the empty stub after each interpolated track.
Mark the animation state dirty by setting the 0x10000 flag on this + 0x4.
When the caller argument a2 is nonzero, clear a 64-bit bitmask at offset 312 of the object pointed to by a2 via BitmaskClear with width 32.
Void return after the track loop and flag update.

unresolved: Packet lists writes to this + 0x4C, +0x50 and +0x54 (interpolated rotation quaternion), but the raw source routes rotation through a local buffer and track offsets +4; the relationship to the listed fields is unclear.
Meaning of the caller bitmask at a2 + 312 and the exact type of a2 depend on the callers.
The 136-byte track element layout and the 44-byte track descriptor stride are read from the raw arithmetic and not independently confirmed.
